name: Mike Jansen
source: Easy going and friendly, Mike is quite popular and seems to fit in anywhere. He is down to earth but also intelligent, with an idealistic streak that often leads him into spots of trouble. He is very focused on his work but unreliable when it comes to chores and personal hygiene. He is currently writing a dark fantasy novel.
